Privacy Policy

Information we collect

When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, mobile number and delivery address. We do not collect payment card numbers; payments are handled by our payment gateway.

How we use your information

We use your personal data to deliver your order, to send order updates by SMS and email, and to handle returns and refunds. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.

Your choices

You may withdraw your consent at any time from your account settings, as easily as you gave it. You have the right to access, correct and erase your personal data held by us.

How long we keep it

We keep order records for as long as tax law requires, and delete the rest when you close your account.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Write to hello@example-shop.in and we will reply within a week.
